note: New strings of the canonical academics screens, all used with inline English defaults. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.academics` wrapper and merge the children into the central `academics` namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw.

learningAreas.title: Learning areas
learningAreas.deleteConfirm: Delete the learning area {{name}}? Its components and teaching groups stay, but no longer resolve.
learningAreas.empty: No learning areas yet. Add the first one.
learningAreas.noInstitution: The canonical database holds no institution row, so a learning area cannot be saved yet.
learningAreas.levelsNote: The levels and pathways of a learning area are kept as stored; this form edits the learning area itself.

components.title: Assessment components
components.empty: No components yet. Add the first one.
components.noInstitution: The canonical database holds no institution row, so a component cannot be saved yet.
components.description: A component is one paper, practical, coursework, oral, project or strand of a learning area.

teachingGroups.title: Teaching groups
teachingGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete the teaching group {{name}}? Its memberships and assignments are not deleted with it.
teachingGroups.empty: No teaching groups yet. Add the first one.
teachingGroups.description: A teaching group joins one class group and one learning area for an academic year. Its members are the learners taught it; its assignments are the teachers.
teachingGroups.required: Name, class group, learning area, academic year and campus are required.
teachingGroups.duplicate: A teaching group with this name already exists for that learning area and year.
teachingGroups.noInstitution: The canonical database holds no institution row, so a teaching group cannot be saved yet.

teachingAssignments.title: Teaching assignments
teachingAssignments.description: An assignment joins a member of staff to a teaching group for a period. The group carries the learning area and the class group.
teachingAssignments.noInstitution: The canonical database holds no institution row, so an assignment cannot be saved yet.

membership.title: Teaching group membership
membership.empty: No memberships yet. Add the first one.
membership.description: A membership places one learner enrolment in one teaching group for a period. Marks can only be entered for a learner who is a member on the assessment date.
membership.noInstitution: The canonical database holds no institution row, so a membership cannot be saved yet.

marksEntry.title: Marks entry
marksEntry.description: A mark belongs to one learner enrolment, one assessment and one learning area. The repository refuses a second mark for the same three, a learner outside the chosen teaching group, and a write made against a version someone else has moved on.
marksEntry.teachingGroupHint: The group fixes the learning area and its members.
marksEntry.choose: Choose an assessment and a teaching group to enter marks.
marksEntry.noMembers: This teaching group has no members on {{date}}. Add memberships on the teaching groups screen first.
marksEntry.saved: Marks saved through the canonical repository.
marksEntry.someRowsInvalid: Some rows need a valid score before the marks can be saved.
marksEntry.notAllSaved: The marks were not all saved.
marksEntry.scoreRequired: Enter a score, or record the learner with a status such as absent.
marksEntry.scoreFormat: A score is a number, for example 78 or 78.5.
marksEntry.scoreAboveMax: A score cannot be above the assessment maximum of {{max}}.
marksEntry.scoreCannotBeCleared: The stored score cannot be cleared: a mark keeps its score once entered. Enter a corrected score, or record a status such as absent.
marksEntry.duplicate: A mark already exists for this learner in this assessment and learning area.
marksEntry.stale: This mark was changed by someone else after it was loaded. Reload the register and enter the score again.
marksEntry.outsideGroup: This learner is not a member of the selected teaching group for this learning area on the assessment date, so the mark was not saved.

errors.duplicate: A record with the same key already exists.
errors.stale: This record changed after you opened it. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid: The form did not pass validation.
errors.reference: A referenced record no longer exists ({{column}}).
errors.permission: You are not allowed to make this change.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved.

status.title: Academic Module Implementation Status
status.curriculumDescription: Learning areas, their components, and teaching groups
status.systemDescription: Education system setup and advanced configurations
